title: Gale Racer
overview:
Scorching oil carries a sense of danger, and the beast's heart - the engine of the machine - roars toward glory.

Only to one who passes countless rivals and overcomes the fear of living side by side with death, whose name is speed, shall it be given: the title of fastest champion, "Gale Racer"...

Gale Racer is a cross-country road race across America, based on the arcade game Rad Mobile. From the driver's seat of a sports car, you speed eastward through a chain of areas, beating a strict time limit while overtaking a field of 23 rival cars. Climb the rankings, chase record and split times, and keep your speed up past the 300 km/h mark. A swinging Sonic the Hedgehog mascot hangs from your car's ceiling, with other characters from the series available too.

- 1 or 2 players
- Memory backup support

焼け付くオイルは危険の予感を漂わせ、野獣の心臓は栄光に向かって雄叫びをあげる。

幾多のライバルたちを抜き去りスピードという名の死と隣り合わせの恐怖を乗り越えた者だけに与えよう。最速の栄冠「GALE RACER」の称号を・・・。
